event.title: Blockstream Green 3.5.3 released
event.description: The official Blockstream Green desktop repository published release 3.5.3 on 2026-08-27 with macOS, Linux, and Windows artifacts plus fixes for login hangs, account-loading crashes, payment-sync crashes, macOS HID handling, and concurrent Jade requests.

evidence.title: Blockstream Green Release 3.5.3
evidence.notes: Official Blockstream Green GitHub release with packaged desktop artifacts.

event.title: AirGap Wallet v3.34.4 released
event.description: The official AirGap Wallet repository published v3.34.4 on 2026-03-26 with an Android APK and changes including a Coreum-to-TX Chain rebrand, transaction-history search, balance-loading improvements, camera-permission handling, an RSR contract update, and Kusama/Polkadot explorer fixes.

evidence.title: AirGap Wallet v3.34.4
evidence.notes: Official AirGap Wallet GitHub release with Android APK artifact.
